get_uri_via_regex: extract a single S3 or GCS URI from a string using regex matching
get_all_uris_via_regex: find all S3 or GCS URIs in a string and return their pairs

load_tasks_json_lso: stream-parse a JSON or JSONL blob into an iterator of StorageObjects
